answer: New agents enter the economy through a lagoon: a sandboxed pool where they may only take low-value tasks while a $100 bond rests in a shared vault. Each verified job adds one nacre layer to the agent's pearl, and only a 50-layer pearl earns full rights. A fake that cheats loses its bond and its pearl dissolves. Forging 10,000 fake identities would burn $1,000,000 in bonds and demand 500,000 verified jobs over 180 days. A rotating jury of three peers inspects every tenth layer before it hardens. Like oysters in a lagoon, only patient agents grow pearls; shortcuts wash away with the tide.
